Messages.Author: Alfred Behrends
Messages.Body:
Can Vamp A play an Amaranth after Vamp B
was sent to torpor via Rotschreck?

Alfred Behrends
Braunschweig, Germany

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Alfred Behrends wrote:
>
> Can Vamp A play an Amaranth after Vamp B
> was sent to torpor via Rotschreck?

No. Amaranth is a combat card; Rotschreck doesn't send the victim
to torpor until after combat.
